profile.summary: Passionate about leading with empathy while getting stuff done. Interested in working with diverse & cross-functional teams. Constantly learning new things.

positions.description: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · Microsoft Azure · React.js · Agentic Workflows

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · Redux.js · GraphQL · NestJS · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led project team of 5 developers to create a server health analytics dashboard and an event-driven data flow pipeline to process voice recordings of Air Traffic Control that will be used to train machine learning models for use in autonomous flight. 
• Utilized Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for data storage, and modernized legacy HTML/CSS using Material-UI React components.
• Owned Jira backlog and distributed workload among team.
• Reduced developer data-processing hours by building UI and RESTful API to automate multithreaded Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes.
• Participated in UX design meetings, gathered design requirements, and incorporated user feedback.
• Reworked object relationships in PostgreSQL database to speed up data extraction times.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
• Develops timelines, business cases, and ROIs for 767 production line optimization projects, and ensures deliverables are met on time. Manages projects for the 767 Factory Support team, a finalist for the 2019 Boeing Engineering Team of the Year. 
• Leads Kaizen activities for continuous improvement of manufacturing processes, then influences manufacturing teams and drives adoption of new and improved processes.
• Analyzes manufacturing KPIs and metrics to perform root cause analyses on chronic system defects. Collaborated with manufacturing to reduce targeted system quality defects by 90% across the KC-46A.
• Utilizes Design for Manufacturing concepts to propose and manage product design changes by coordinating with engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers. Through these design changes, has independently reduced production costs by $2.1 million/yr. 
• Designs new tooling in CATIA and utilizes 3D-printing for rapid prototyping. Designed and implemented new tools that have reduced production costs by $150,000/yr.
• Provides on-site manufacturing support to multiple sites by troubleshooting system failures and communicating process requirements and best practices to manufacturing teams.
• Writes Python scripts to assist in data mining and automate data analysis. 
• Selected to speak at an enterprise-wide executive leadership webcast about the success of the Factory Support team model, demonstrating strong communication skills to senior leadership.

positions.title: Tech Support
positions.description:
• Facilitate user-software interactions between students, professors, and Ohio State's eLearning Management System, Canvas
• Collaborate with users, software engineers, and PMs to identify unique solutions requiring analytical and quick problem-solving skills

positions.title: Industrial Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Analyzed inefficient and unsafe sort operation, designed new conveyor belt and ramp system to improve efficiency and safety, and implemented new operating plan that could save up to $54,000 
• Developed new work measurements for airport operations
• Planned 2019 volume and production by analyzing past trends and staying within business plan

positions.title: Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Commissioned new optical comparator machine, developed installation qualifications and SOPs, and created engineering study to identify most efficient method of use
• Performed preventative maintenance gap analysis on boiler and reverse osmosis utility systems and added necessary PMs into CMMS

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted time studies and worked with manufacturing supervisors and line operators to reduce time required for product changeovers and increase yearly profits by over $3,000,000
• Reduced Clean-in-Place time on two manufacturing lines by 22% by creating SOPs and conducting training with line operators
• Performed Risk Assessment of eight manufacturing lines and created solutions for identified risks
